chapter: Brother's trumpet and the early players
title: Mutes: coconut shell, derby and plunger, and rock and roll
summary: Rene tells how mute ideas came from Buddy Petit's derby, a coconut shell and a plunger used by Chris Kelly, and ends by arguing jazz will outlast rock and roll.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
